# The DESI Sikka

> The DESI Sikka is a crypto news and updates site for readers worldwide, with deep coverage of India. It covers bitcoin, ethereum, altcoins, crypto regulation (global policy plus Indian specifics: 30% tax, 1% TDS, FIU rules), DeFi and Web3 explainers, exchange guides, price predictions, airdrops and daily market combos. Plain English, no jargon walls, no paid shilling.

Site: https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/
Author: F9XR News Desk (https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/author/f9xr/)
Language: English

## Main sections

- [Latest Crypto News](https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/): newest stories on the homepage
- [Bitcoin](https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/category/bitcoin/): BTC moves, halvings, ETF flows
- [Ethereum](https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/category/ethereum/): ETH upgrades, staking, L2s
- [Altcoins](https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/category/altcoins/): SOL, XRP, memecoins and what is actually building
- [Regulation](https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/category/regulation/): global policy plus RBI, Income Tax, TDS, FIU updates for India
- [DeFi & Web3](https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/category/defi/): yield, protocols, self-custody
- [Exchanges & How-to](https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/category/exchanges/): INR on-ramps, P2P safety, tax filing steps
- [Price Predictions](https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/pages/predictions/): analyst calls as clearly-labeled opinion
- [Featured Articles](https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/pages/featured/): editor's picks
- [Press Releases](https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/press/): company announcements, labeled separately from reporting
- [Videos](https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/pages/videos/): recaps and explainers
- [Airdrops](https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/pages/airdrops/): live airdrops, eligibility, scam warnings
- [Today's Combo](https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/pages/todays-combo/): one daily card of top story, key level, tax note, airdrop
- [Events](https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/pages/events/): conferences, hackathons, meetups, unlocks
- [Archive](https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/archive/): every story by date
- [About](https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/about/): who we are
- [Search](https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/pages/search/): full-text search across stories
